headlines.text: 2023 brought us this moment: Komander touched down in AEW for the first time in a Ladder match against Powerhouse Hobbs vs. Action Andretti vs. AR Fox vs. Eddie Kingston vs. Konosuke Takeshita vs. Ortiz vs. Sammy Guevara, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.73 ? a good, competitive contest. The masked luchador made a spectacular AEW debut in the Face of the Revolution Ladder Match ? competing without a signed contract, which soon drew interest from WWE as well.
On this day in 2025, O'Reilly & Strong vs. FTR crossed paths for the first time ever, getting things started right out of the gate on Collision, rated 7.67 ? a strong outing.

Flash back to 2021, when Nyla Rose vs. Thunder Rosa met in a Tournament Final, in the show-closing main event slot on AEW Women's World Title Tournament, rated 5.68, part of the special USA Bracket - Final card.

secondaries.text: Rewind to 2025, when the AEW TNT Title was up for grabs as Daniel Garcia vs. Adam Cole went to war, appearing on Collision, rated 7.05 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle.
Back on this day in 2023, Orange Cassidy vs. Big Bill fought tooth and nail for the AEW All-Atlantic Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.92. It was the first title opportunity of Big Bill's career.
It was 2023 when Mike Bennett was back in action after just under 2 months away, appearing on Dynamite.
